channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Reunião pós-derrota de Lula com Messias, Guimarães e Wagner acaba no Alvorada
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Attorney General Jorge Messias following the Senate's rejection of Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, which failed with 42 votes against and 34 in favor. The meeting took place at the Palácio do Alvorada on Wednesday evening, the 29th, and included advisors Guimarães and Wagner. The gathering served as a post-defeat evaluation and strategic adjustment in institutional relations.

item.title: Voz de Alcolumbre vaza e antecipa derrota de Messias: 'Vai perder por oito'
item.description: Before the official result of the Senate vote that rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, Congress President Davi Alcolumbre accurately predicted the final vote would be eight against. His remarks were leaked on Wednesday, the 29th, sparking debate over the transparency of the legislative process.

item.title: Mendonça diz que o Brasil perdeu grande ministro com rejeição de Messias
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça lamented the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, stating Brazil lost the opportunity to have a great minister. Lula's nomination was defeated 42-34, marking a political setback for the government in an election year. Mendonça praised Messias as a true friend and man of integrity, noting both are evangelicals.

item.title: Celso de Mello diz que Senado cometeu grave equívoco institucional
item.description: Retired Supreme Court Justice Celso de Mello criticized the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF as a 'grave institutional error,' stating that the Attorney General fully meets the constitutional requirements for the position. He called the decision unjustifiable and said it represented a missed opportunity to bring a serious, experienced jurist committed to democratic values to the Court.

item.title: Eleição pressionou resultado negativo de Jorge Messias, avalia governo
item.description: Government leader in Congress, Senator Randolfe Rodrigues, attributed the rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination to the electoral environment, stating that President Lula's choice was correct but pressured by political context. The vote resulted in 42 against and 34 in favor, falling short of the 41 needed, with one abstention. This marks only the sixth rejection of a STF nomination in Brazilian history, the last occurring in 1894.

item.title: Antes de Messias, Senado rejeitou apenas cinco indicados para o STF, há 132 anos
item.description: Before the rejection of Jorge Messias on April 29, 2025, the Senate’s last negative vote on a presidential STF nomination occurred in 1894 — 132 years ago. Five nominees were rejected that year by President Floriano Peixoto, including physician Candido Barata Ribeiro, who served 10 months before being rejected. The rejections took place amid institutional crisis, including the Armada Revolt and executive-judiciary tensions, under the 1891 Constitution which allowed senatorial review after appointment.

item.title: Derrota de Lula é sem precedentes desde o século 19
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva suffered a historic defeat in the Senate as his nominee to the Supreme Federal Court, Jorge Messias, was rejected with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, falling short of the 41 needed for confirmation. This marks the first time in over a century that the Senate has blocked a presidential nominee to the STF, echoing a pattern seen only during the presidency of Floriano Peixoto at the end of the 19th century, when five nominations were rejected, with only one briefly assuming the role.

item.title: O que explica derrota histórica de Lula no Senado (e qual recado envia ao STF)
item.description: The historic rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Federal Court by the Senate, with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, marks a significant defeat for Lula, highlighting his political fragility amid low approval ratings and pressure from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Analysts say the vote served as a message to the STF, which is weakened by the Banco Master scandal and divided over a code of conduct, and that Lula is unlikely to secure another nomination before the October elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre indica que vaga no STF ficará para o próximo presidente
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre indicated that the upcoming vacancy on the Supreme Federal Court (STF) will be filled by the president elected in October 2026, not by the current president Lula. He signaled to the opposition that he does not intend to bring forward a new nomination made by the federal government, following the Senate plenary's rejection of a prior proposal. The decision reflects an institutional move to avoid further politicization amid heightened political polarization.

item.title: Derrota de Messias no Senado surpreende ministros do STF
item.description: The Federal Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court by a vote of 42 to 34, surprising the justices who had expected a narrow approval. This marks the first time in 132 years that the Senate has blocked a presidential nominee to the STF, with the last occurrence dating back to 1894 under Marshal Floriano Peixoto. Justices André Mendonça, Gilmar Mendes, and Edson Fachin had publicly advocated for Messias, whose confirmation was anticipated to shift the court's internal balance toward a more restrained faction.

item.title: STF diz respeitar prerrogativa do Senado na rejeição de Messias
item.description: The STF issued a statement affirming its respect for the Senate's decision to reject Jorge Messias's nomination to the Court, following 42 opposing and 34 favorable votes. The defeat constitutes a political setback for Lula in an election year, highlighting the government's difficulties in congressional articulation. The STF Presidency said it awaits, with serenity, the constitutional procedures to fill the vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso.

item.title: 'Rejeição de Messias é vitória para Alcolumbre, mas ele vai ter que lidar com o efeito rebote disso', diz analista
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, marks a historic defeat for the Lula government and a political victory for Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, underscoring the government's weak legislative articulation. Although Alcolumbre wins in the short term, he faces a potential 'backlash effect,' as the decision may strengthen congressional independence and complicate future negotiations with the Executive.

item.title: ‘Sabemos quem fez isso’, diz Messias após rejeição de seu nome para STF no Senado
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias was rejected by the Senate as Lula's nominee for the Supreme Court, marking the first such rejection in 132 years. He claimed to know who orchestrated a campaign to destroy his image, though he did not name them, and expressed frustration over Senate President Davi Alcolumbre's opposition following Lula's decision not to nominate Rodrigo Pacheco. Despite the defeat, Messias said he was treated respectfully by most senators and accepted the outcome as part of the democratic process.

item.title: ‘Vai perder por oito’: Alcolumbre tem voz vazada e antecipa derrota de Messias no Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre accurately predicted the rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination by 8 votes, whispering 'he will lose by eight' to government leader Jaques Wagner. The final vote was 42 against, 34 in favor, and one abstention — the first Senate rejection of a Supreme Court nominee in 132 years. Alcolumbre had backed Rodrigo Pacheco, creating a rift with President Lula, who supported Messias.

item.title: “Minha história não acaba aqui”, diz Jorge Messias
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias expressed disappointment over the Senate's rejection of his Supreme Court nomination, stating the defeat does not mark the end of his story and that he endured a campaign to undermine his image. He implied Senate President Davi Alcolumbre led opposition efforts without naming him directly. Though he received 34 votes—short of the 41 needed—Messias maintained composure, praised the process's transparency, and affirmed his confidence in his career and integrity.

item.title: ‘Não é simples alguém com minha trajetória passar por reprovação’, diz Messias, rejeitado para o STF
item.description: Union Attorney-General Jorge Messias was rejected by the Senate for a STF seat after an eight-hour hearing and approval in the CCJ, receiving 34 favorable votes, 42 against, and one abstention. He expressed personal frustration, emphasized his career as a public servant, and accused unnamed actors of spreading lies to undermine his image. STF President Edson Fachin stated the Court awaits, with serenity and institutional responsibility, the necessary steps to fill the vacancy.

item.title: Lula se reúne com Messias no Alvorada após derrota histórica no Senado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Attorney General Jorge Messias at the Alvorada Palace following the historic defeat of Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, which received 34 votes in favor and 42 against — eight short of the required majority. The meeting also included Minister of Institutional Relations José Guimarães and Senate government leader Jaques Wagner. Messias said he endured a five-month campaign of image destruction, accusing the opposition and Senate leadership, particularly President Davi Alcolumbre, of spreading lies to block his appointment.

item.title: Alcolumbre previu diferença de oito votos contra indicação de Messias ao STF pouco antes da revelação do resultado; vídeo
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre accurately predicted the rejection of Jorge Messias' Supreme Court nomination by eight votes, shortly before the result was made public. The nomination failed with 34 votes in favor and 42 against, falling short of the 41 needed for approval. Alcolumbre had been asked by government leader Jaques Wagner about the vote count and shared his assessment, underscoring his experience in Senate proceedings.

item.title: Coordenador do Prerrogativas diz que viu Cunha em Alcolumbre por rejeição de Messias
item.description: Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, coordinator of the Prerrogativas movement, criticized Senate President Davi Alcolumbre for leading the historic rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination, comparing him to Eduardo Cunha. He argued that the defeat reflects a failure in governability and the checks-and-balances system, not a loss for Lula, whom he calls the 'only adult in the room'. Alcolumbre had advocated for Rodrigo Pacheco as an alternative and delayed the nomination for months, despite its approval in the CCJ.

item.title: Senado rejeita indicado de Lula ao STF e oposição fala em ‘fim do governo’
item.description: The Brazilian Senate rejected President Lula's nominee Jorge Messias for the Supreme Federal Court in a historic vote of 34 in favor and 42 against — the first presidential defeat on an STF nomination since 1894. Bolsonarist opposition celebrated the result as a sign of the 'end of the government,' while Messias expressed disappointment, stating 'we know who did this,' without naming individuals directly.

item.title: Aliados de Lula defendem que ele não indique novo nome ao STF neste ano
item.description: Allies of President Lula (PT) argue he should refrain from appointing a new name to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) this year, leaving the seat vacant after Jorge Messias's defeat in the nomination attempt. They contend that restraint prevents further politicization and safeguards the Court's independence.

item.title: Esquerda fala em crise e pede mobilização do povo contra o Congresso
item.description: Allies of Lula's government (PT) protested on social media against the rejection of Jorge Messias for a STF seat, a nominee previously indicated by the president. The mobilization aims to pressure Congress and denounce what they see as an attack on judicial independence and the progressive agenda.

item.title: Rejeição de Messias antecipa desembarque de Alcolumbre e do Centrão
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court anticipates the departure of Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and much of the Centrão from Lula's congressional base, accelerating the debate over Senate presidency succession in February. The move reveals fragility in the government's political articulation and growing pressure for realignment of forces in Congress.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que derrota de Messias é sinal de que ‘governo Lula acabou’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claims the rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF signals the end of Lula’s government governability, stating 'the government is over'. He calls the outcome expected and asserts Lula will not be re-elected, possibly as early as 2026. The vote was historic, with 42 against and 34 in favor, and Bolsonaro denies having organized opposition to the nominee.

item.title: El Senado de Brasil impone una derrota histórica a Lula al rechazar su candidato a juez del tribunal Supremo
item.description: The Brazilian Senate rejected President Lula’s nominee, Jorge Messias, for a vacancy on the Supreme Federal Court, marking the first such defeat since 1894. The decision, made less than six months ahead of the 2026 elections, represents a rare misalignment between the Executive and Legislative branches, particularly notable given Messias’ close ties to Lula and his former role as Attorney General of the Union. The outcome signals growing political resistance to presidential judicial nominations in a tense election year.

item.title: O governo dos sete erros
item.description: Lula's government suffered another defeat in Congress with the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Tribunal by a vote of 42 to 34. This loss adds to a series of setbacks in areas such as the economy, environment, and security, evoking the infamous 7-1 defeat. Lula appears not to have realized that his political influence has waned.

item.title: Após rejeição de Messias, governo cobra explicações do Senado
item.description: The federal government's nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court was rejected by the Senate with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, marking the first presidential STF nomination rejection in 132 years. Minister José Guimarães stated the government accepts the decision calmly but demanded the Senate explain its reasoning, emphasizing Messias meets all constitutional requirements and was described as a 'slave to the Constitution'.

item.title: Ação de Alcolumbre, pressão sobre o STF e soberba de Lula; veja análises sobre a rejeição de Messias
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, with 34 votes in favor and 42 against, was orchestrated by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who preferred Rodrigo Pacheco. The defeat for Lula was seen as a message to the STF amid scandals like the Banco Master case and as a warning that the Senate could pursue impeachment against justices.

item.title: Fachin diz que STF aguarda nova indicação após rejeição de Messias
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin stated that the Court respects the Senate's decision to reject Jorge Messias' nomination and awaits constitutional measures to fill the vacancy. He emphasized respect for the Senate's prerogative and the personal and institutional histories of those involved, noting that republican life strengthens when disagreements are handled with elevation and public responsibility. The rejection followed delays and political maneuvering, with Justice André Mendonça lamenting the loss of an opportunity for Brazil to have a 'great minister'.

item.title: “Não é simples, mas Senado é soberano”, diz Messias após rejeição
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias spoke following the Senate's rejection of his Supreme Court nomination, stating he acted with integrity throughout the process and accepted the outcome as part of democratic procedure. He emphasized the sovereignty of the Senate plenary, thanked those who supported him, and expressed faith in God's plan for his life, describing the episode as a stage, not an end.

item.title: Oposição celebra rejeição de Messias ao STF enquanto governo atribui derrota a 'chantagem política'
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court by a vote of 42 to 34, marking the first presidential nomination rejection for the STF since 1894. The opposition celebrated it as a historic victory against left-wing state apparatus, while the government blamed 'political blackmail'. Senators Flávio Bolsonaro and Sergio Moro emphasized the need for an independent judiciary.

item.title: Crusoé: Moro equipara Lula a Floriano Peixoto após rejeição de Messias
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-RJ) compared President Lula to former president Floriano Peixoto following the Senate's rejection of Attorney General Jorge Messias for a seat on the Supreme Federal Court (STF). Moro noted that Messias is the first nominee rejected since 1894, the same year Floriano Peixoto faced a similar parliamentary rebuke. The comment was made amid growing political debate over judicial independence and inter-branch tensions in Brazil.

item.title: Ministro diz que Lula vê derrota de Messias como natural numa democracia
item.description: The Minister of Secom, Sidônio Palmeira, stated that President Lula (PT) is tranquil about the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, calling the outcome natural in a democracy. The comment was made in a column interview, reflecting the government's stance amid the impasse over the Supreme Court appointment.

item.title: Rejeição a Messias no Senado é histórica e não acontecia há 132 anos; saiba mais
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, with 34 votes in favor and 42 against. This marks the first time since 1892 that a presidential nominee for the STF has been rejected, making it a historic event in Brazilian politics. The vote reflects strong opposition to Lula's chosen candidate.

item.title: “Governo Lula acabou”, diz Flávio após rejeição de Messias
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) declared that "Lula's government is over" after the Senate rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), voting 42 to 34 against Lula's pick. He posted "Lula's government is over. GREAT DAY" on X (formerly Twitter), celebrating the government's defeat.

item.title: As primeiras percepções do governo Lula após derrota de Messias no Senado
item.description: The defeat of Jorge Messias in the Senate vote for the STF, with 34 votes in favor and 42 against, was seen as a significant political setback at the Planalto Palace, particularly because it was driven by the opposition and the Centrão, suggesting coordinated resistance to Lula’s nomination. The government assesses that revisiting the issue before the October elections is not feasible, with reconsideration possible only if Lula is re-elected, and rules out Rodrigo Pacheco as a backup option, viewing it as a concession to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who had favored the Minas Gerais senator for the position.

item.title: Messias recebe telefonema de consolação de Lula
item.description: Union Attorney General Jorge Messias received a consoling phone call from President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva after the Federal Senate rejected his nomination to the Supreme Federal Court. The call was facilitated by Senate government leader Jaques Wagner while Messias was surrounded by allies in the government leadership.

item.title: Mendonça defende Messias e diz que Brasil ‘perde a oportunidade de ter um grande ministro’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça publicly defended the rejected nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, stating Brazil misses the opportunity to have a great minister. Mendonça praised Messias’s integrity and constitutional qualifications, urging him to leave the battle with his head held high.

item.title: Jaques Wagner se encontra com Lula após derrota de Messias
item.description: Senate Government Leader Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) met with President Lula after the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court, which failed with 42 votes against and 34 in favor — short of the 41 needed for approval. The process has been archived, and Lula must now submit a new nominee for the vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso, restarting the CCJ review and full Senate vote.

item.title: TSE vence 4º Prêmio Social Media Gov na categoria melhor trend de 2025
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) won the 4th Social Media Gov Award in the 'Best Meme/Trend of the Year' category for 2025 with the piece 'Urna-Chan loves free, fair and transparent elections', published on TikTok. Created by Júlia Araújo of TSE's Secom, the initiative used humor and casual language to engage youth and demystify electronic voting machines. The award was presented at the 15th National Public Communication Forum in Florianópolis.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Derrota não é de Messias, mas do governo Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attributed the rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Federal Court to the Lula government, stating the defeat reflects the president’s attempt to place a third ally on the Court. He noted that the 42 votes against, while insufficient for impeachment, signal a societal message to STF justices regarding judicial overreach. Flávio labeled Lula’s appointees in this term, Cristiano Zanin and Flávio Dino, as militants and views the outcome as a warning to the Court.

item.title: Acessibilidade nos locais de votação e eleições do futuro são tema de evento no TSE
item.description: The TSE held the event 'Electoral Justice for All: Together for Accessibility and Inclusion,' bringing together electoral justice staff from across Brazil to discuss actions for a more inclusive democracy. Key topics included accessibility at polling places and future elections, focusing on overcoming barriers for people with disabilities, particularly in non-adapted venues like public schools.

item.title: “Vitória do povo”, diz líder da oposição sobre rejeição de Messias
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF), leader of the opposition in Congress, celebrated the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, which was voted down 42 to 34. He described the outcome as a 'victory for the people'.

item.title: Messias diz após derrota no Senado que passou por processo de 'desconstrução' durante campanha por vaga ao STF: 'Sabemos quem comandou'
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias was rejected by the Senate in his nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), receiving only 34 votes — seven short of the required majority. He described the process as a 'deconstruction' and blamed political maneuvers, particularly by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, for orchestrating his defeat. The rejection marks the first time since Brazil's redemocratization that an STF nominee has been blocked by the Senate, delivering a historic blow to President Lula’s administration and heightening tensions with Congress ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Rejeição Messias: indicado por Bolsonaro, ministro André Mendonça diz que 'Brasil perde a oportunidade de ter um grande ministro do Supremo'
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro, lamented the historic rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF, stating that Brazil loses the opportunity to have a great justice. Mendonça praised Messias's character, integrity, and constitutional qualifications, and offered personal and spiritual support.

item.title: “Brasil perde a oportunidade de ter um grande ministro”, diz Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça criticized the Senate's rejection of Attorney General Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF, saying Brazil missed the chance to have a 'great' minister. Mendonça praised Messias's integrity and qualifications, citing a biblical reference to support him following the Senate vote.

item.title: Próximo presidente indicará quatro ministros ao STF
item.description: Following the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, the president elected in 2026 will appoint four justices to the Supreme Federal Court. This is due to the vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso not being filled by the current administration, increasing the number of appointments for the next president. The report was first published by O Antagonista.

item.title: Alcolumbre articulou derrota de Messias e mandou recado ao STF e a Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre secretly orchestrated the defeat of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, securing only 34 favorable votes against the required 41. The effort involved senators from parties such as Republicans, PSD, União Brasil, and Avante, alongside the pre-existing bloc of PL and Novo. The loss was seen as a message to the STF regarding its alleged 'hypertrophy' and to President Lula for overlooking Alcolumbre’s preferred candidate, Rodrigo Pacheco.

item.title: 'A vida é assim', diz Messias após ter nome rejeitado no Senado
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias spoke for the first time after his nomination to the Supreme Federal Court was rejected by the Senate, expressing gratitude for the support received and accepting the outcome as part of the democratic process. He said life includes both victories and defeats, and that this is not the end of his journey. The secret vote resulted in 42 against, 34 in favor, and one abstention — the first presidential Supreme Court nomination rejected since 1894.

item.title: Mendonça lamenta rejeição de Messias para o STF: ‘Brasil perde a oportunidade de ter um grande ministro do Supremo’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça expressed regret over the Senate's rejection of Attorney General Messias's nomination to the STF, stating that Brazil loses the chance to have a great minister. Mendonça affirmed Messias possesses integrity, strong character, and meets all constitutional requirements for the position, emphasizing their shared evangelical faith and Bolsonaro-era alignment.
